items.criterion: The textfile writer is reachable from the shipped CLI entrypoint (bin/speclang start), not only from the spec-dir sources
items.detail: bin/speclang:265 requires ../dist/src/daemon/index.js; dist/src/daemon/daemon.js:25 requires ./daemon-prom and :247 calls writeDaemonPromMetrics with the same publishMetrics call sites as the source. The CLI lifecycle test (tests/daemon/daemon-prom.test.ts:96-148) spawned `node bin/speclang start --no-dashboard` and observed daemon.prom with up=1 on start, timestamp advancing on a watched cascade, and up=0 after SIGTERM — passed in the vitest run (exit_code=0).

items.criterion: A metrics-write failure must not turn a pipeline success into a failure (telemetry failure path)
items.detail: publishMetrics wraps the write in try/catch and warns (specs/daemon.spec.dir/src/daemon.ts:285-297); tests/daemon/daemon-prom-outcomes.test.ts:51-67 mocks writeDaemonPromMetrics to reject and asserts pipeline_success still fires, pipeline_failed does not, and console.warn receives '[Daemon] Failed to write .speclang/daemon.prom:' — passed in the vitest run (13 passed, exit_code=0).
